text: The cohesive HoTT axiom 'pieces have points' (Π = ∫) means:
choices: every cohesive space is a set
the shape functor ∫ preserves the unit (∫1 ≃ 1)
the terminal object is preserved by ∫
∫ maps every type to a single point
explanation: 'Pieces have points' (Lawvere): ∫ preserves the terminal object (∫* ≃ *). More precisely, the counit ε: ∫A → A has a section, meaning every connected component has at least one point.
